Episode 246: The Battle for the Mitra Desert (15)
Since the spatial collapse began, Vahn had been solely focused on defense.
The only time she attacked outside the rift was when she sent out Beliz and Linpa.
Even that wasn't strictly an attack, but merely exerting 'a little' force to open a path for the two.
That power tore through the dimensional rift, spilling out to whirlwind through the heart of the desert, obliterating the Red Plutonian reconnaissance group that was there.
Now she intended to launch a full-blown attack on the unidentified enemies.
Swoosh…!
With a cold metallic sound, Vahn's sword emerged from its scabbard. Lekan, the cherished sword she used before completing Sigmund.
As Vahn's aura began to flow into the blade, a roar reminiscent of a wild beast resounded. Lekan eagerly absorbed the aura it hadn't felt in a long time.
In terms of power, even Sigmund, or any other sword in this world, couldn't compare. Lekan was designed from the outset to withstand Vahn's vast aura.
Thus, its blade was more rugged than other famed swords and lacked any ornate decorations. Whatever was missing, Vahn herself would compensate.
The condensed aura sharpened the blade infinitely, and the blue lightning flowing endlessly from the sword manifested the majesty of a God to the enemies.
"Hmm…!"
The aura forming the barrier was reverting to Vahn's heart and sword.
As a result, the weight the Battle Kings had to bear increased rapidly. But as Vahn's aura amplified, the resonance with the brothers strengthened.
The Plutonian clan becomes strongest when resonating with the Battle God. The barrier had shrunk, but they now shone like a massive beacon of light.
Nothing seemed capable of penetrating this luminous cluster.
Soon, Vahn began to move. With each step she took, the temple of the Battle God trembled heavily.
And the trajectory of the enemy lightning cannons and magic spears, which were hammering Lafrarosa, changed. Some even vanished mid-air, unable to withstand her aura.
Occasionally, especially potent enemy lightning or magic tried to strike directly, but then Vahn would swing Lekan and deflect them personally.
Her single stroke erased hundreds of incoming attacks without a trace.
Once unleashed, her sword's energy continued to dominate the skies, undiminished.
The energy of the sword clashed with enemy lightning and magic, intertwining like warring armies. Vahn silently observed her expanding blade energy for a while.
To closely observe the characteristics of the enemies' energy.

Vahn first focused on the magic. Unlike the enemy's energy, the spears of magic showed a trait of scattering upon contact with Vahn's sword aura, attempting to regain their original form instead of disintegrating instantly.

'The magic of creation... No, it's more precisely the power of a divine being. Just like the power of witches or solderet, it has an upper hand against all energies. Perhaps a being like the witch's avatar? It's strange and dangerous. Yet, they're not utilizing this power properly.'
Vahn quickly finished her assessment of Elona. To her, Elona seemed incapable of fully utilizing the transcendent power she possessed.

Primarily because the power wasn't acquired through rigorous training. Moreover, due to the countless experiments performed by Zipfel, Elona was, comparatively, in a state where she couldn't even use her limbs effectively.
It was as if her powers had become impaired. Elona was supposed to be far stronger and a more complete being than she appeared now.
Soon, Vahn's gaze shifted to the Red Plutonian’s energy.

'...Indeed, this is not the energy of the bio-weapon called ‘Shadow Human(명인)’ that Jin's brothers talked about. Although there's a gap in cohesion and purity, many aspects are too similar. It's certainly the energy of beings who could be termed as our sub-species. What on earth has happened outside? Were there hiding Plutonian species?'
If it had been ‘Shadow Human(명인)’, the feeling of discomfort would have been lesser. After all, the enemies would merely be bio-weapons following orders.
But the attack of the same Plutonian species, perhaps termed as sub-species, was clearly a challenge.
A bold challenge claiming the ownership of the name 'Plutonian'. Or, a will to deny the entire Plutonian species of Lafrarosa.
This infuriated Vahn. Following her rage, the energy in her Heart of Light and Lekan became even more fierce.
“I swear on the name of Plutonian. If we get out of here, not one of you will step foot in this world alive.”
Shadow King Sword Battle God First Sword Technique
Annihilation
Vahn swung Lekan horizontally with both hands.

At that moment, the siblings gritted their teeth and solidified their protective shields for one another, to withstand the backlash of the energy emanating from Lekan. This time, they had to protect the normal soldiers.
A gigantic sword aura, too vast to grasp in a single glance, began to split the sky in half.
Vahn's furious strike showed a wild and rugged momentum, unbelievably brutal for a human sword.
The Red Plutonian energy and chunks of magic that came into contact with that sword aura were torn and shredded messily, too brutally to merely describe as being sliced.
'Annihilation' initially shot out in a straight line, but afterward, it swirled throughout the sky like a freely swimming whale, pulverizing the enemy energy and magic.
It was like unleashing a beast inside a fence filled with live prey.
However, because new enemy brains and magic spears kept pouring out through the cracks, the ‘Annihilation’ attack continued to scour the airspace.

Now, even outside the cracks in the vast desert, the changes in Lafrarosa were noticed. The Red Plutonian was surprised by the energy pouring into the desert from Vahn, and Elona strengthened the protective barrier, reclaiming some of the dispersed magic from the battlefield.
“Just because you're trapped doesn't mean you're dead, and just because there's no trace doesn't mean you've disappeared. From now on, you will be trampled and crushed in dreadful days."
Shadow Sword Battle God 10th Sword Technique
Extinction
Tzuhahaak-!
Behind Vahn, ten pairs of glowing wings spread out.
The massive, blue wings cast a gentle shadow over the brothers' heads first. The brothers, fully charged, roared, shaking Vahn's back.

The energy of the enemies facing the wings came to a sudden stop. The Red Plutonian Energy melted like ice in a flame and dropped to the ground, while the shattered magic spears swirled aimlessly in mid-air.
Then, as the wings tilted forward along with Lekan, whirlwinds of energy sprouted wherever Vahn's eyes reached.

The storm from the ten pairs of wings vomited energy out towards the cracks. With a deafening sound, the dimensional cracks tore, and the King's race felt space contracting even more intensely than before.
It was because of the reaction of this dimension that Vahn did not unleash her Shadow’s domain sword now.
Beliz and Linpa were already sent out, and surely outside, Jin and the remaining brothers must be struggling to retrieve them.
There was no need to further endanger the brothers now.
Since the day she was promised freedom from Jin, that faith has never wavered.
"Until we get out, hold onto your fragile lives."
Lastly, Vahn gazed at the largest crack in front of her.
It was a crack newly formed from the recent clash. With the naked eye, one couldn't see what lay beyond the crack, but Vahn felt the enemies as if they were standing right in front of him.
The wings and the swirling energy began to gather into Lekan's sword form.
At that moment, the enemies felt Vahn's glowing gaze from across the dimension.
Vahn felt their emotions too. From the very first day he held a sword until now, it was the most familiar emotion Vahn ever felt from others.
Fear and despair.
Faces of the enemies engulfed in terror, which couldn't be hidden even by the vast distance between dimensions, were being swallowed in Vahn's eyes.
A single slash.
Vahn's strike, swift as a flash of light, went through the dimensional crack, targeting the enemies who had believed they were safe all this time.
Just before Vahn was about to strike, Shimat instinctively shouted.
"Open the bridge!"
Being of the same lineage, he intuited it. Something indescribably dangerous was about to escape from the dimensional rift and strike the aerial fortress and fleet.
Outside the bridge, Vahn's aura, the Red Plutonian aura, and Elona's magic were mingling, creating a barrier.
Shimat quickly took his position in front of the rift, slashing his way with Tetallon. Unlike him, who had to defend the fleet, Elona had already retreated and was extending her protective shield.
Had he been even slightly late, the entire fleet stationed in front of Pibil would have been annihilated.
"Gasp!"
Shimat swung the Tetallon with all his might above the rift, feeling as if he had stepped into a trap.
Krzzz...!
Moments later, Vahn's sword energy began to erupt from outside the rift. The enemy tribe timed their support fire from the aerial fortress with the moment Shimat parried the energy.
While the attacks from the Red Plutonian and Elona weakened as they passed through the dimensional rift, Vahn's sword energy didn't reach its target in full strength either.
Still, that sword energy obliterated the Red Plutonian's vanguard fleet and even reached Shimat. The protective aura Shimat had hastily erected was completely torn apart.
The moment it clashed with Vahn's sword energy, Shimat was engulfed in a strange sensation of his head going blank.
It wasn't because the sword energy was unbearably heavy. Even without support from the aerial fortress, he could easily fend off such diminished sword energy.
It was just that the feeling was incomprehensible, causing his mind to halt momentarily. Even in its weakened state, Vahn's sword held the intensity to freeze even Shimat.
'Is this really the descendant of the Blue Plutonians...?'
A chilling sensation pricked the back of his neck.
Then, a surge of frustration rose. While the Blue Plutonian left behind such a descendant without any preparations, it seemed the Red Plutonian had no such blessings.
"All fleets! Increase the distance from Lafrarosa...!"
As he was about to give an order, Shimat felt another sword energy approaching through the rift. But this energy wasn't as fierce or vast as before.
It was as thin as a thread, as fast as light, and as silent as midnight, seemingly unbreakable and unstoppable.
Shimat didn't need to swing the Tetallon to counter this energy. The second energy wasn't aimed at the Red Plutonian but at Elona Zipfel.
